We’re excited to share the Kimina-Prover Preview, a state-of-the-art formal reasoning model built for theorem proving in Lean! This work is a joint collaboration between Project Numina and the Kimi Team.

Leveraging an innovative reinforcement learning pipeline to explore proofs in a reasoning-driven manner, closely resembling human problem-solving strategies. This enables more intuitive and effective proof discovery, achieving a new State-of-the-Art result of 80.7% on the miniF2F benchmark.

We’ve open-sourced distilled versions of Kimina-Prover with 1.5B and 7B parameters for wide use by the Lean community. These come alongside our autoformalizer model and a revised version of the miniF2F benchmark. We are committed to building tools that benefit the Lean community, and we hope this release will accelerate the theorem-proving process while sparking the development of new tools and ideas.

This is just the beginning—stay tuned for more announcements soon! :rocket:
